description: Finish the email flow started by claim: pass the token from the email. A claim token records that address as the org's claimed email. A recover token only confirms the mailbox; to get a seat back use recover_seat with it. Opening the link in a browser does not confirm; this call does. The token is the only authorization; no seat is needed. Not idempotent.

token.description: The token from the claim or recover email (the raw token or the full link).

name: confirm_claim
title: Confirm claim email
